summary: Decision spike. The diff from base 00ebe80 touches only backlog/ (decision-5, task-7.29 notes, new tasks 7.43/7.44/7.45), dreams/limit-holdem-trainer/requirements.md (REQ-035.6 wording, changelog 1.14) and doit/ workflow files. No source, scripts, package manifests, dependencies, persisted formats or randomness changed, so there is no reachable path from untrusted input to a dangerous operation. A scan for secrets (keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) found nothing; the only matches were the substring in 'task-' file names. The new REQ-035.6 formula (d x observed PFR / typical PFR, capped at 100) divides by a fixed midpoint constant from REQ-046.1 that is never zero, and it reads only observed in-app stats. Nothing to flag for FU-B, though its implementation review should confirm the cap is applied and that the formula never reads bot internals (REQ-035.3). Spec section 8 (N/A) is accurate.
